contentFull:
Czech Republic targets pork self-sufficiency with digitalisation push

The Czech Republic has rolled out a new programme to rebuild its struggling pork sector, putting digitalisation at the centre of efforts to boost domestic production. Pork self-sufficiency reportedly has slumped to a record-low 46.1%, leaving the country reliant on imports for more than half of its consumption.

Vladislav VorotnikovEastern Europe correspondent

Oct 3

News

The Czech government also plans to modernise the infrastructure that turns pigs into market-ready pork. Photo: Twan Wiermans

The strategy envisages a broad digital overhaul of Czech pig production. The strategy covers several key technology areas, with the automation of core production processes at its centre.
